annotations.title: Attach an X account to a follower line item (paused)

description: THE CREATIVE OF AN X FOLLOWER CAMPAIGN. A line item with objective FOLLOWERS (productType PROMOTED_ACCOUNT, which create_x_ads_line_item now defaults to for FOLLOWERS) promotes an X ACCOUNT, and until one is attached here it has nothing to show and never serves. Omit userId and the ad account’s own promotable account is used; if it may promote several, the choice is refused rather than guessed (list_x_ads_promotable_users shows them). A line item of any other product type is refused for free, naming X’s INCOMPATIBLE_LINE_ITEM rule. You may ALSO attach a post with create_x_ads_promoted_tweet, which X adds as a mobile timeline placement. The attachment is READ BACK from the line item before it is reported. Nothing spends: the campaign and line item stay PAUSED until set_x_ads_status(confirm:true). X cannot edit a promoted account, only remove it (delete_x_ads_object type:"promoted_account"). Free.

adAccountId.description: X ad account id (list_x_ads_accounts); omit if only one is shared

lineItemId.description: a PROMOTED_ACCOUNT line item (objective FOLLOWERS) from create_x_ads_line_item

userId.description: the numeric X user id to promote — omit for the ad account’s own promotable account
